messages:
sam_eng_sre: Apiserver leases drifting ~30s in eu-west1 — controller-manager reconciliation for gpu-node-pool keeps re-creating nodes and GPU attach flaps. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: ALERT: apiserver: lease_renewal_failures > 5% in eu-west1 (last 5m) :rotating_light:

maria_oncall: Yep, just got the page. Pods are Pending with AttachVolume errors and controller-manager is looping CreateNode -> DeleteNode for the gpu-* pools.

lee_platform: I pulled apiserver + etcd logs. apiserver returning lots of 503s for watch/list endpoints around the lease spikes. etcd leader rotated twice in ~3m. Looks correlated with NAT egress spike to our snapshot S3 endpoint.

juan_sre: Confirmed etcd leader flips. Network egress from control-plane VMs jumped, and we see increased tail-latency on storage uploads. Control-plane VMs are not CPU bound. Suspect NAT gateway queueing.

sam_eng_sre: controller-manager logs: `E0320 14:10:12.345678 1 leaderelection.go:321] error retrieving lease: Get "https://apiserver:443/apis/coordination.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/kube-system/leases/kube-controller-manager": net/http: request canceled` — renewals timing out.

maria_oncall: kubectl output paste:```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-23    NotReady   node     2h    v1.26.3
gpu-node-24    Ready      node     3h    v1.26.3

Events:
  Warning  FailedAttachVolume  5m (x12 over 3m) AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "pvc-1234-abc": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```

lee_platform: On top of NAT, I see a bunch of long-lived list/watch responses from the GPU provisioner which amplify apiserver traffic. When watch endpoints stall, prober systems retry and the fanning increases.

juan_sre: Workaround idea: increase controller-manager --lease-duration to 60s and renewDeadline to 40s temporarily. That buys time while we fix egress shaping. Not ideal but less churn.

cost-ops: Heads up: this churn is creating on-demand instances from reserved pools — cost spike ~+$1.2k in eu-west1 over the last hour. We should throttle reconciler or pause some auto-scaling groups.

sam_eng_sre: Two immediate asks: (1) route control-plane egress to a dedicated NAT per zone to avoid cross-tenant queueing, (2) rate-limit snapshot/uploads from control-plane. Also consider short-circuiting heavy watchers with KV prefix caching.

lee_platform: I'll open a runbook PR with those mitigations and pin snapshot schedule off-peak. Also going to test lowering watch-cache TTL for the provisioner to reduce list sizes.

maria_oncall: For immediate mitigation I've scaled down non-critical GPU node pools in eu-west1 and applied an admission hook to throttle massive node create requests from the provisioner. That stopped the create/delete loop.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: mitigation in progress. Paging cleared for now.

sam_eng_sre: Follow-up: need a permanent fix — investigate apiserver proxy FD limits + NAT egress burst shaping, and add a throttling circuit in the provisioner. I'll file a ticket and schedule a postmortem. :memo:
